slot.chapter: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
slot.subtopic: de Broglie wavelength of accelerated particles
slot.brief: Compare the de Broglie wavelengths of two particles accelerated through the same potential difference.

stem: Two ions $X$ and $Y$, of masses $5m$ and $20m$ and charges $+e$ and $+4e$, respectively, start from rest and are accelerated through the same potential difference. What is the ratio of their de Broglie wavelengths, $\dfrac{\lambda_X}{\lambda_Y}$?

verdicts.working: For an ion accelerated from rest through potential difference V, p=√(2mqV) and λ=h/p. Thus λX/λY=√[(20m·4e)/(5m·e)]=4.

working:
$\lambda=\dfrac{h}{\sqrt{2mqV}}$.
$\dfrac{\lambda_X}{\lambda_Y}=\sqrt{\dfrac{m_Yq_Y}{m_Xq_X}}=\sqrt{\dfrac{20m\cdot4e}{5m\cdot e}}=4$.

Independent check: For an ion accelerated from rest through potential difference V, p=√(2mqV) and λ=h/p. Thus λX/λY=√[(20m·4e)/(5m·e)]=4.
solution:
For an ion accelerated from rest through potential difference $V$, $\lambda=\dfrac{h}{\sqrt{2mqV}}$.
$$\dfrac{\lambda_X}{\lambda_Y}=\sqrt{\dfrac{m_Yq_Y}{m_Xq_X}}=\sqrt{\dfrac{20m\cdot4e}{5m\cdot e}}=4$$
